dedupe_keys.name: camera and telemetry data from slovak roads in various light and weather conditions

description: Camera and telemetry data from Slovak roads in various light and weather conditions is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Marek Galinski et al. In this paper, we describe the dataset captured with our proprietary data capture solution mounted on top of a Land Rover Defender vehicle. The captured data are the real data of drives on various Slovak roads. Coverage: not stated; published in 2024. The formats are not stated in the sources read. The paper's page was read, but no repository address could be taken from its machine-readable metadata, so the record links to the article, whose Data Records section names where the data sit. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence of the data is not stated in the sources read (the paper itself is open access). Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
